## Change

What changes and why.

## Change class (QMS section 4)

- [ ] Minor: no effect on the model, the Safety Engine, the thresholds or the intended purpose
- [ ] Significant: changes the model, the Safety Engine, the thresholds or the intended purpose. Needs an entry in CHANGELOG.md, a risk review and a new conformity check before release.

## Checks

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and ci passes
- [ ] Risk register reviewed (docs/compliance/risk-management.md)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated
